algorithm: SHA256(seed NUL benchmark NUL kind NUL identifier), ascending priority
design: Three tasks without replacement from the complete eligible list
goal: Environment execution and replay of native grades; model task success is not the acceptance criterion
replacement_policy: No replacement for missing assets, setup failures, grade failures or task difficulty
scope: All distinct competition/problem_idx tasks in the 27 captured MathArena output releases, including proof and multimodal tasks; no filtering by graders, setup or model performance.
